name: Eighth Leg
description: Four arms where the hand has three, and the one that was added is the amber one reaching past the rest — the find gives +1 arm and 20% more reach, so it is drawn as the leg you can see was put there rather than as a plate you have to read. Same knuckle and the same ss.lib.spider-arm as the slot icon; only the count and that one arm's colour differ, which is the whole of what the find does.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
